templates.pattern: [M] kg of water is heated from [T1]°C to [T2]°C. How much energy is required? (Specific heat capacity of water = 4200 J/kg°C)
[M] kg of an unknown metal absorbs [E] J of energy and its temperature rises by [DT]°C. What is its specific heat capacity?
templates.explanation: Specific Heat Capacity c = E ÷ (mΔT) = [E] ÷ ([M] × [DT]) = [E] ÷ [M*DT] = [RESULT] J/kg°C

templates.pattern: A [V] V supply drives a current of [I] A through a resistor for [T] seconds. How much electrical energy is transferred?
templates.explanation: Electrical Energy = V × I × t = [V] × [I] × [T] = [RESULT] J

templates.pattern: A [V] V appliance draws [I] A of current. What is its power consumption?
A [R] Ω resistor carries a current of [I] A. What is its power dissipation?
A pump with [EFF]% efficiency raises [M] kg of water to a height of [H] m in [T] seconds. What is the electrical power input to the pump? (g = 10 m/s²)
templates.explanation: Useful power = mgh÷t = [M]×10×[H]÷[T] = [M*10*H/T] W. Input power = useful power × 100 ÷ efficiency = [M*10*H*100/T/EFF] = [RESULT] W

templates.pattern: An object of mass [M] kg slides down a slope from height [H] m and reaches the bottom at [V] m/s. How much energy was lost to friction? (g = 10 m/s²)
templates.explanation: Energy lost = GPE − KE = mgh − ½mv² = [M]×10×[H] − 0.5×[M]×[V]² = [M*10*H] − [0.5*M*V*V] = [RESULT] J

templates.pattern: A household uses [KWH] kWh of electricity. If the cost per kWh is [COST] pence, what is the total cost in pence?
templates.explanation: Total cost = energy used × cost per unit = [KWH] × [COST] = [RESULT] pence

templates.pattern: A spring with spring constant [K] N/m is compressed by [X] m. How much elastic potential energy is stored?
A power station generates [PO] MW of useful power from [PI] MW of input power. What is its efficiency as a percentage?
templates.explanation: Efficiency = (Useful Power Output ÷ Total Power Input) × 100 = ([PO] ÷ [PI]) × 100 = [RESULT]%
